title: [Master]-Opening price list from Customer Card is extremely slow on large datasets (~220s) due to AddAllSourceType call
summary: Opening a price list from the Customer Card is made faster on large datasets, where it took around 220 seconds because of the AddAllSourceType call. The logic in Price List Management is reworked and UI tests are added.
key_points: Addresses slow opening of price lists from the Customer Card on large datasets (~220s)
Title attributes the slowness to the AddAllSourceType call
Changes are in the Price List Management codeunit
New tests added in the Price Lists UI test codeunit
